reply.rationale: No defensible compositional paradigm is supported by this codebook. The single multi-character form 1L has no substitutional family showing that 1 contributes a stable count meaning or that L recurs with a stable lamp meaning in the same frame. The one-character symbols B, D, C, H, F, T, O, S, and R each denote distinct holistic patterns, not members of an attested substitution class inside a shared construction. Per the evidence requirements and opaque-index test, the safest analysis is a flat lexicon with every symbol treated as an unanalyzed stored label.
